upper_wall_geometry_revision.material_provenance: Project modeled finer masonry and genuinely curved clay tile, not CC0 geometry; unedited project generated stone + licensed rock_01 microdetail.

upper_bricks.merge_method: all original native BoxMesh VERTEX/NORMAL/TANGENT/UV arrays concatenated in row/column order; every original INDEX offset by actual preceding vertex count; no dropped attribute or geometry reduction
upper_bricks.method: lo=-2.5+column*.25+odd*.125; hi=min(lo+.25,2.5); odd first lo=-2.5; center=(lo+hi)/2; BoxMesh stored arrays translated, no custom fake-normal brick grid

upper_wall_geometry_revision.support_method: Actual used-index minimum2% over complete new native bounds; require old/new support vector/count/minY byteexact, not old bbox alpha equality.
upper_wall_geometry_revision.support_scope: Complete new used-index minimum2% algorithm, not retained subset-only measurement.

v5_revision.normal_tangent_recipe: Existing clockwise INDEX triangles; -cross area-weighted vertex NORMAL then original TANGENT projected orthogonal to actual NORMAL; original tangent.w retained; no culling fallback
v5_revision.scope: NEW upper vertices/normals/tangents/alpha/cast; not a texture trick. Same count/INDEX/UV, original14 retained arrays, worldfoot/collision/source layout/nav. Complete used-index support/count/minY remains an actual capture gate, not assumed here.

upper_brick_shoulder.formula: x += sign(x)*.12*smoothstep(.90,1.38,y)*(1-smoothstep(1.38,1.665,y)); y/z unchanged; existing per-brick faces become genuine sloped shoulder
